table.name: item_sku
table.Comment: 二手商品SKU具体的规格表

column.name: menu_type
column.Comment: 菜单类型 (M目录 C菜单 F按钮)

column.name: role_name
column.Comment: 角色名称 (如: 超级管理员)

column.name: role_key
column.Comment: 角色权限字符串 (如: admin)

column.name: biz_type
column.Comment: 业务类型: 1-商品SPU留言, 2-社区帖子评论

column.name: biz_id
column.Comment: 业务目标ID (对应 SPU_ID 或 POST_ID)

column.name: parent_id
column.Comment: 父评论ID (0表示是对文章/商品的直接首条评论)

column.name: reply_to_user_id
column.Comment: 被回复人的用户ID (针对楼中楼回复)

column.name: is_deleted
column.Comment: 逻辑删除标识(0-正常, 1-已删除)

column.name: biz_type
column.Comment: 点赞目标类型: 1-商品SPU, 2-社区帖子, 3-评论

column.name: is_deleted
column.Comment: 是否取消点赞(0-点赞中, 1-已取消)

index.name: uk_user_biz
index.Comment: 联合唯一索引: 防止同一个用户对同一个目标重复点赞

column.name: relate_spu_id
column.Comment: 关联的商品SPU ID(如果是在分享具体商品)

column.name: status
column.Comment: 状态: 0-待审核, 1-正常可见, 2-被封禁/隐藏

column.name: is_deleted
column.Comment: 逻辑删除标识(0-正常, 1-已删除)

column.name: name
column.Comment: 分类名称 (例: 手机数码, 运动户外)

column.name: sort
column.Comment: 排序权重 (数值越小越靠前)

column.name: is_deleted
column.Comment: 逻辑删除: 0-未删除, 1-已删除

column.name: sku_id
column.Comment: 关联的规格 SKU ID (如果改的是SPU统一价，此字段可为空)

column.name: operator_id
column.Comment: 操作人ID (通常就是卖家ID，或者是后台管理员强行改价)

column.name: is_deleted
column.Comment: 逻辑删除标志(0-正常，1-已删除)

column.name: spu_id
column.Comment: 关联的SPU_ID (指向 item_spu 表的 id)

column.name: images
column.Comment: SKU专属图片 (选黑色手机时，主图要切成黑色的)

column.name: publish_price
column.Comment: 该规格首次发布时的价格 (用于SKU级别的降价计算)

column.name: locked_stock
column.Comment: 锁定库存 (被拍下但未支付的临时冻结库存)

column.name: version
column.Comment: 乐观锁版本号 (扣减此SKU库存时防超卖使用)

column.name: own_spec
column.Comment: SKU规格属性 (JSON格式，例：{"颜色":"黑色","内存":"128G"})

column.name: status
column.Comment: 状态: 0-下架, 1-上架 (允许某个特定颜色的手机单独下架)

column.name: is_deleted
column.Comment: 逻辑删除标志(0-正常，1-已删除)

column.name: id
column.Comment: 主键ID (建议雪花算法生成)

column.name: title
column.Comment: 商品标题 (例如：自用99新国行iPhone 13)

column.name: original_price
column.Comment: 入手原价 (单位:元，计算保值率用)

column.name: allow_offer
column.Comment: 是否允许砍价/议价: 0-否(一口价), 1-是

column.name: city
column.Comment: 商品所在地-城市 (同城交易过滤核心)

column.name: images
column.Comment: 商品的主图URL列表 (多张逗号分隔)

column.name: sale_attrs
column.Comment: 动态销售属性值(Map键值对)

column.name: status
column.Comment: 状态: 0-已下架, 1-售卖中, 2-交易中(被拍下未付款), 3-已售出

column.name: favorite_count
column.Comment: 收藏数/想要数 (热度核心指标)

column.name: comment_count
column.Comment: 留言/评论数 (互动核心指标)

column.name: is_deleted
column.Comment: 逻辑删除: 0-未删除, 1-已删除

column.name: original_price
column.Comment: 发起砍价时的原价(防商品改价)

column.name: status
column.Comment: 状态: 0-待处理, 1-卖家同意, 2-卖家拒绝, 3-买家取消, 4-已生成订单失效

column.name: item_spu_id
column.Comment: 商品SPU ID (冗余用于统计)

column.name: offer_id
column.Comment: 关联的砍价Offer ID(无砍价则为NULL)

column.name: status
column.Comment: 状态: 10-待支付, 20-已支付, 30-已发货, 40-已完成, 50-已取消

column.name: finish_time
column.Comment: 成交时间(确认收货时间)

column.name: payment_no
column.Comment: 支付/退款流水号(本系统生成)

column.name: trade_no
column.Comment: 第三方支付网关的交易流水号(如微信/支付宝交易号)

column.name: channel
column.Comment: 支付渠道: 1-支付宝, 2-微信支付, 3-模拟余额支付

column.name: status
column.Comment: 支付状态: 0-待支付, 1-支付成功, 2-支付失败, 3-已退款, 4-交易关闭

column.name: error_msg
column.Comment: 第三方返回的错误描述

column.name: extra_data
column.Comment: 第三方回调原始报文及扩展信息

column.name: pay_time
column.Comment: 实际支付/退款完成时间

column.name: is_deleted
column.Comment: 逻辑删除标志(0-正常, 1-已删除)

index.name: uk_order_type
index.Comment: 保证同一订单的同类交易不重复

column.name: update_time
column.Comment: 最后搜索时间(用于排序)

column.name: is_deleted
column.Comment: 逻辑删除标志 (0-正常, 1-删除)

index.name: idx_user_id
index.Comment: 加速按用户查询地址薄

column.name: is_deleted
column.Comment: 逻辑删除: 0-未删除, 1-已删除

index.name: uk_user_spu
index.Comment: 联合唯一索引：同一个商品只记录一条，重复看只更新时间

index.name: idx_user_update
index.Comment: 联合索引：加速查询用户的最近浏览记录

column.name: is_deleted
column.Comment: 逻辑删除: 0-未删除, 1-已删除

index.name: uk_user_spu
index.Comment: 联合唯一索引：防止同一个用户重复收藏同一个商品

column.name: phone
column.Comment: 手机号(唯一，预留手机登录)

column.name: email
column.Comment: 电子邮箱(唯一，预留邮箱登录)

column.name: credit_score
column.Comment: 信用积分(满分100，违规扣分)

column.name: status
column.Comment: 账号状态：1-正常，0-封禁锁死

column.name: is_deleted
column.Comment: 逻辑删除：0-未删除，1-已删除

column.name: praise_rate
column.Comment: 好评率(百分比，例如 98.50，默认100)

column.name: is_deleted
column.Comment: 逻辑删除标识(0-正常, 1-已删除)
